title: 美方前能源官员提议柴油出口与库存挂钩
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Diesel export ban, you studied it too.
segments.zh: 柴油出口禁令，你也研究过。

segments.en: Look, in 2022, I looked at a product.
What do we do about it? We were at $5 a gallon and gasoline in June of 2022.
segments.zh: 我们该怎么办？2022年6月，汽油价格达到每加仑5美元。

segments.en: I don't believe that we have to look at this just as a ban or no ban.
segments.zh: 我不认为我们必须只从禁或不禁的角度来看待这个问题。

segments.en: There's clearly a problem when we are exporting significant amounts and we are getting to points that could be price points in the United States.
segments.zh: 当我们大量出口，并且达到可能影响美国价格的水平时，显然存在问题。

segments.en: It could be damaging to the economy and lead you eventually down to a recession.
segments.zh: 这可能对经济造成损害，并最终导致经济下行。

segments.en: So you can't just say, oh, we can't do anything about it because there's some purity test of we don't export.
segments.zh: 所以你不能说，哦，我们无能为力，因为有不出口的纯洁性测试。

segments.en: And by the way, for decades, we didn't export any crude and I negotiated the deal with Senator Morkowski at the time in 2015 or 2016 to allow exports.
segments.zh: 顺便说一句，几十年来，我们没有出口任何原油，我在2015年或2016年与时任参议员穆尔科斯基谈判达成了允许出口的协议。

segments.en: So it's not like this thing that we've always done exports.
segments.zh: 所以并不是我们一直在做出口这件事。

segments.en: I think that we have to look at a policy that ties our exports levels to inventories.
segments.zh: 我认为我们必须考虑一种将出口水平与库存挂钩的政策。

segments.en: And so when we have commercial inventories and government inventories of diesel and gasoline at a certain level, you are free to export as much as you want.
segments.zh: 当商业库存和政府库存的柴油和汽油处于一定水平时，你可以自由出口任意数量。

segments.en: When they get reduced by a certain amount, exports get reduced by a certain amount.
segments.zh: 当它们减少一定量时，出口也相应减少一定量。

segments.en: It doesn't have to be a ban or no ban. We can actually limit volume of exports.
segments.zh: 不一定是禁止或不禁止。我们实际上可以限制出口量。

segments.en: We can restrict it to no increases in exports, et cetera.
segments.zh: 我们可以限制出口不增加等等。

segments.en: There are things that levers that we can do and I think that we got into the wrong place of discussing this as a totally binary ban or no ban.
segments.zh: 我们可以采取一些杠杆措施，我认为我们陷入了错误的方向，将其讨论为完全二元禁止或不禁止。
